newsitem.title: HONG KONG: New World launches new telephone services.
newsitem.headline: New World launches new telephone services.

text.p: New World Telephone Group, a subsidiary of New World Development Co Ltd, said on Monday it has launched a new communications services "MultiCom Centrex" to organisations of any size in Hong Kong.

The new feature-rich fixed network telephony system which includes voice mail, speeding dialling and caller number display features, provides direct access to network services and from international calling to local communications, it said.
New World Telephone's commercial director Franky Lai said the company would invest half a billion Hong Kong dollars in "MultiCom Centrex" infrastructure and premium equipment in the next 12 months.
"We aim to capture seven percent of the local telephone market share with 300,000 lines installed by the year 2000," Lai said.
New World Telephone provides telecommunications services including fixed, mobile, PCS (personal communication service) and multimedia services to individuals and corporations.
